import calendar
from datetime import date

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    # Parse the input date
    y, m, d = map(int, day.split('-'))
    # Compute new month and year
    total_month = m - 1 + n  # zero-based month index
    new_year = y + total_month // 12
    new_month = total_month % 12 + 1
    # Days in target month
    _, last_day = calendar.monthrange(new_year, new_month)
    # Determine if original date was last day of its month
    _, last_orig_day = calendar.monthrange(y, m)
    if d == last_orig_day:
        new_day = last_day
    else:
        new_day = min(d, last_day)
    return f"{new_year:04d}-{new_month:02d}-{new_day:02d}"
